name: Closing lift
look: The last content section scrolls away like a sheet and uncovers the closing photograph held under it; the photograph settles from a close crop and the closing line with the one action fades up on it.
reduced: A plain closing section with the photograph, the line and the action.
phone: A plain closing section with the photograph, the line and the action after the sheet.

needs.words: a closing line of 3 to 7 words, one line and one action; the closing section of its own, the footer after it
needs.picture: a calm, darker lower half where the words stand (sand, water, a wall, a table); the words never on a busy part
